bullets.text: slept nine hours and woke up tired anyway. the body keeps its own books.
duck still at okunoin. candle glyph, light rain on the moss between graves. the line splits sleeping from resting. the cedars do neither.
descaling the kettle with vinegar. the whole kitchen smells like a salad that gave up.
an umbrella has been leaning in the lobby for days. nobody claims it. everybody steps around it politely.
the cat sleeps. the cat rests. the cat refuses to say which.
